question: Where is the headquarters of the National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The headquarters of the **National Remote Sensing Centre **(NRSC) is located in **Hyderabad**.
 
• NRSC is a part of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and it is responsible for remote sensing satellite data acquisition and processing.
